final: SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.rental_rate / NULLIF(f.rental_duration, 0)) AS per_rating_average, COUNT(*) AS film_count, AVG(f.rental_rate / NULLIF(f.rental_duration, 0)) / (SELECT AVG(per_rating_average) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS per_rating_average FROM film GROUP BY rating)) AS average_divided_by_overall FROM film f WHERE f.rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND f.rental_duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.rating HAVING (SELECT AVG(per_rating_average) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS per_rating_average FROM film GROUP BY rating)) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.rating
